question: A plane wavefront is incident at the boundary of two media. If $v_1 = v_2$, what will be the relation between $i$ and $r$? Justify.

options.B: If $v_1=v_2$, then $i+r=90^\circ$, so the ray bends towards the normal.
options.C: If $v_1=v_2$, refraction cannot occur and the wavefront is reflected.
options.D: From $\dfrac{\sin i}{\sin r}=\dfrac{v_1}{v_2}=1$, we get $\sin i=\sin r$, so for ordinary angles $i=r$. Therefore, there is no bending.
